_column_contract: Summit's cover box runs Current | Last(=Previous, 2024 sheet) | Cumulative — the REVERSE of the parsed cities' sheet. All three columns are captured VERBATIM and LABELLED here; the builder promotes one per the rule documented in CLAUDE.md. "" = the cell was EMPTY (or a slashed-zero / dash nil mark) on the form; null = a value is present but ILLEGIBLE and was never guessed.

contributions.detail: no schedule page exists in this document - nothing to reconcile. The cover states $250.00 cumulative from donors over $50 and $0.00 from donors at or under $50.

_meta_itemized.page_gates: NOTHING TO GATE - THE DOCUMENT IS ONE PAGE. pdfinfo reports Pages: 1 and index.csv agrees; page 1 was rendered at 200 dpi and read once to CLASSIFY it, not for money, and it is the split50 'CAMPAIGN FINANCIAL REPORTS (Utah Code 17-16-6.5)' cover and nothing else - candidate/office/party lines, the four-row Current|Last|Cumulative box, the certification paragraph, the signature and the handwritten date '12-9-16'. There is no ITEMIZED CONTRIBUTION REPORT page and no itemized expenditure page in this PDF, so both sides are 'none' (non-existence), never a zero.

geometry.basis: rule-detection row banding (rowbands.py) on the page's own printed grid; box spans the full table width of the row

_meta_itemized.notes: Kim Carson's 2016 POST-ELECTION filing is a COVER-ONLY re-file: its cover box is cell-for-cell identical to her PRE-ELECTION sheet (3983) - Current $250.00 / Last $0.00 / Cumulative $250.00 on the >$50 row, $0.00 across the <=$50 row, $250.00 / $0.00 / $250.00 expenditures, $0.00 balance throughout - but where 3983 carries two ledger pages, this one carries none. So the money is unchanged between the two reports and the itemization for this candidate-cycle lives entirely on 3983's pages 2-3. This is the same behaviour the module records for Robinson/Wright/Jones/Olson/Francis/Armstrong/Larsen/Welch/Poll (an unchanged re-file of the pre-election sheet as the post-election report); Carson is not on that published list, so this is a NEW instance of the pattern and worth adding to it. The signature date is handwritten '12-9-16', already carried by the cover cache. No street address or PO box was written into this record.
